title: Ted Wacker Receives Prestigious DK Global Golden Advocate Award
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Ted Wacker Receives Prestigious DK Global Golden Advocate Award
metaDescription: Ted Wacker of TBW Law receives DK Global's Golden Advocate Award 2024, highlighting his innovative use of visual presentation technology in successful trials, including the notable Koganti case.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
We are proud to announce that Ted Wacker, founding partner of TBW Law, has been honored with DK Global's Golden Advocate Award for 2024. This prestigious recognition celebrates excellence in trial advocacy and innovative use of visual presentation technologies in the courtroom.

Wacker, renowned for his groundbreaking approach to personal injury litigation, was particularly recognized for his masterful utilization of DK Global's visualization technologies in recent high-stakes trials. The award highlights his ability to effectively communicate complex case details to juries through compelling visual presentations.

In discussing the award, Wacker emphasized the transformative impact of DK Global's visualization tools, particularly in the landmark Koganti case. He noted how the accident reconstruction video and detailed injury animations proved instrumental in helping the jury comprehend the full scope and severity of the incident. These sophisticated visual tools brought clarity to complex technical aspects of the case, enabling jurors to better understand the sequence of events and resulting injuries.

"Visual presentation is crucial in modern trial advocacy," Wacker explained. "DK Global's animations and reconstructions allow us to tell our client's story in a way that words alone simply cannot achieve. In the Koganti case, their visualization tools were invaluable in illustrating the true nature of the accident and its devastating impact."

The Golden Advocate Award recognizes not only Wacker's successful trial outcomes but also his innovative approach to case presentation. His strategic use of cutting-edge visual technology demonstrates TBW Law's commitment to leveraging advanced tools and techniques to achieve the best possible results for their clients.

This recognition further solidifies TBW Law's position as a leading personal injury firm in Southern California, known for combining traditional legal expertise with modern presentation technologies. The firm's success in utilizing these advanced visualization tools reflects their ongoing commitment to excellence in trial advocacy and their dedication to securing justice for their clients.

The award adds to Wacker's impressive list of accolades and reinforces TBW Law's reputation for excellence in personal injury litigation. It serves as a testament to the firm's innovative approach to trial presentation and their commitment to staying at the forefront of legal technology.

We are excited to share that Ted Wacker, founding partner of TBW Law, has been featured in a compelling spotlight interview with Modern Luxury magazine. The feature offers an intimate look at the journey and philosophy of one of Orange County's most respected personal injury attorneys.

From his early days as a competitive soccer player in Seattle to becoming a distinguished trial attorney, Wacker's path to legal excellence has been marked by determination and passion. Following in the footsteps of his father, a Seattle judge, Wacker graduated from the University of San Diego School of Law in 1991, launching what would become a remarkable career in personal injury law.

His legal journey includes pivotal experiences that shaped his approach to advocacy, including work on the historic Exxon Valdez Oil Spill case during his clerkship at Casey Gerry. After gaining valuable experience at Robinson Calcagnie under the mentorship of legendary attorney Mark P. Robinson, Jr., Wacker founded TBW Law in Newport Beach, creating a firm dedicated to fighting for justice on behalf of individuals facing personal tragedy.

The Modern Luxury feature highlights Wacker's impressive track record, including a $51 million Vioxx verdict and significant settlements of $12.65 million for a brain injury case and $21.2 million against U-Haul. These achievements reflect the firm's commitment to their motto, "Perseverance with Passion," which has guided their practice since its founding in 2014.

As a former President of the Orange County Trial Lawyers Association and member of the American Board of Trial Advocates, Wacker emphasizes the importance of balancing zealous advocacy with professional civility. His approach draws interesting parallels between his athletic background and legal practice, viewing both as arenas where excellence is achieved through disciplined adherence to rules and ethical principles.

The legacy of legal excellence continues in the Wacker family, with his daughter Kelly currently pursuing her law degree at USD Law School, following in both her father's and grandfather's footsteps. title: Koganti Achieves Big Settlement Against Defendant
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Koganti Achieves Big Settlement Against Defendant
metaDescription: Read about the recent case victory that surpassed all expectations.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
$15.23 Million Settlement for Amputation Injury Victim

‍

At TBW Law, we are proud to have secured a $15.23 million settlement for Karteek Koganti, an international student who suffered life-altering injuries in a tragic accident caused by a distracted truck driver.

Karteek was traveling with five friends on a road trip across the United States when an 18-wheeler struck their van on a Pennsylvania highway. The truck driver, distracted while retrieving a fallen headset, failed to stop for slowed traffic in a construction zone. The collision propelled the van forward into another vehicle and a U-Haul truck, leaving Karteek with critical injuries and rendering him an incomplete paraplegic.

As an uninsured international student, Karteek faced immense challenges, including being far from his family and without access to adequate medical care. TBW Law immediately stepped in, raising over $100,000 to transfer him to a specialized rehab facility and advocating tirelessly for justice on his behalf.

The case faced numerous legal hurdles, including disputes over the liability of PODS, the company outsourcing the truck’s services. After extensive litigation and appeals, we successfully overturned a motion for summary judgment and built a compelling case with expert testimonies, medical evaluations, and powerful visual animations reconstructing the accident and injuries.

Despite the defense’s initial resistance, mediation efforts resulted in a $15.23 million settlement for Karteek. An additional $760,000 was awarded to the other victims, bringing the total resolution to $15.99 million.

This outcome reflects TBW Law’s dedication to securing justice and financial security for clients facing catastrophic injuries. We remain committed to fighting for those who need it most, ensuring their voices are heard and their futures protected.

‍

Contact Us Today

If you have been injured in a U-Haul accident, we encourage you to contact us today for a free consultation. We will review your case and help you understand your legal rights and options. We will fight for the maximum compensation possible so that you can focus on your recovery.

TBW Law Proudly Sponsors "An Evening with Cliff McCrath"

TBW Law is thrilled to announce its title sponsorship of "An Evening with Cliff McCrath," a celebration of soccer excellence and community spirit. This highly anticipated event will take place on Wednesday, October 30, at the Hilton Bellevue, with doors opening at 6 p.m. and the program commencing at 7 p.m.

As a family-owned personal injury law firm with deep Seattle roots, TBW Law has been a stalwart supporter of the local soccer community since the 1970s. Our commitment to the sport and its positive impact on our community aligns perfectly with the goals of this extraordinary event.

Ted Wacker, founder of TBW Law and a Seattle native, expressed his enthusiasm: "We are honored to sponsor this tribute to Washington soccer icon, Cliff 'Uncle Nubby' McCrath. Cliff's leadership and mentorship have been a beacon of inspiration within our community, nurturing and developing youth with strength, integrity, and compassion. His indomitable spirit has inspired countless individuals to achieve success in all facets of life. To the Legend, we raise a heartfelt cheer!"

The event serves as a fundraiser for WA Legends and the Jimmy Gabriel Memorial Scholarship, underscoring TBW Law's dedication to supporting education and preserving the rich soccer heritage of Washington State. Erin Mayovsky of FOX 13 will serve as the master of ceremonies, adding to the evening's prestige.

Frank Gallo, president of WA Legends, praised the partnership: "TBW Law is the ideal partner for this event. We share a profound love for the game and a deep reverence for Coach McCrath and his immense contribution to the growth and spirit of our soccer community. This event not only pays tribute to Cliff and his 54 years of creative brilliance in Seattle but also enables our organization to raise awareness of our great soccer heritage and invest in education for youth in need."

The connection between TBW Law and the local soccer scene runs deep. Ted and Doug Wacker, who manages the firm's Washington office, were raised in north Seattle and played for Shorecrest High School and the Seattle Youth Soccer Association's Seattle United, winning two state cups in the 1980s. Ted's soccer journey continued at San Diego State, where he was part of a significant Seattle contingent that led the Aztecs to the 1987 NCAA Division I final.

Mark your calendars for June 4, 2024, as TBW Law's founding partner, Ted Wacker, takes the stage at the highly anticipated TLU Trial Skills Bootcamp in Huntington Beach, California. Unlocking the Secrets of a $21.2 Million Verdict

Ted Wacker, renowned for his exceptional trial advocacy, will share his invaluable insights on "Overcoming Significant Hurdles on the Way to a $21.2 Million Verdict." This comprehensive presentation will cover a wide range of crucial topics that can make or break your case in the courtroom.

What You'll Learn:

  1. Expert Handling: Master the art of taking effective expert depositions on video and selecting the best experts for your case.
  2. Witness Preparation: Learn techniques to prepare your client and witnesses for compelling trial testimony.
  3. Storytelling in the Courtroom: Discover how to use scene-based storytelling for impactful opening statements.
  4. Medical Record Navigation: Find and contextualize issues in medical records to strengthen your case.
  5. Visual Persuasion: Harness the power of exhibits and visual aids during witness examinations.
  6. Educating the Judge: Learn to use PowerPoint slides effectively to educate the judge on relevant law.

  8. Comprehensive Storytelling: Utilize friends and family testimonies to enhance your client's narrative.
  9. Life Care Planning: Ensure your life care plans are realistic and reasonable for future care costs.

  11. Demonstrating Life Changes: Effectively describe pre- and post-accident changes in the plaintiff's life.
  12. Child Witnesses: Best practices for handling young children as witnesses at trial.
  13. Client Presentation: Learn when and how to have the plaintiff appear in court for maximum impact.
  14. Capitalizing on Defense Mistakes: Turn opposition errors into advantages for your case.
  15. Expert Testimony Strategies: Navigate the use of rebuttal experts and exclusion of testimony through motions in limine.
  16. Jury Selection Mastery: Techniques for addressing challenging facts during voir dire to neutralize bias and exclude prejudiced jurors.

title: Roman Family Awarded $21.2 Million in U-Haul Negligence Case
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Roman Family Awarded $21.2 Million in U-Haul Negligence Case
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
Roman Family Awarded $21.2 Million in U-Haul Negligence Case

At TBW Law, we are honored to have secured a $21.2 million verdict on behalf of the Roman family in the case of Roman v. U-Haul. This result reflects our unwavering commitment to achieving justice for our clients and holding negligent parties accountable.

This case arose from a devastating incident caused by a U-Haul employee who attempted an unsafe pass on a two-lane road, leading to a head-on collision with Mr. Roman’s vehicle. As a result of this reckless act, Mr. Roman sustained severe injuries to his head, neck, shoulder, elbow, and knee. These injuries necessitated multiple surgeries, including procedures on his right elbow and left knee, and have had a lasting impact on his quality of life.

Despite the defense’s attempts to minimize accountability by arguing that Mr. Roman’s actions contributed to the accident and limiting damages to less than $1 million, the jury saw the truth. After a thorough two-week trial in Los Angeles Superior Court - Antelope Valley (Lancaster), they awarded Mr. Roman $21.2 million to cover his pain, suffering, and extensive medical expenses.

This verdict stands as a testament to the power of thorough preparation, diligent advocacy, and the courage to take a case to trial. Before trial, U-Haul offered the Roman family just $2 million to settle—a figure that failed to reflect the severity of Mr. Roman’s injuries and the profound impact on his life. By pursuing this case to its rightful conclusion, we ensured that U-Haul was held fully accountable for their negligence.

We believe this award will provide the Roman family with the resources they need to rebuild their lives. While no monetary amount can undo the harm caused, this verdict ensures that Mr. Roman’s medical needs and financial security are addressed for the future.

At TBW Law, we fight tirelessly for individuals and families who have been wronged. This case highlights the importance of seeking justice in the face of adversity, and we are proud to have delivered this life-changing result for the Roman family.

title: 5 Essential Steps to Take If You're Injured in an Accident
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / 5 Essential Steps to Take If You're Injured in an Accident
metaDescription: Vaping has gotten more popular, with 11 million in the U.S. using such products. It’s why we pulled together everything you need to know - learn more.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
Accidents can happen unexpectedly and leave you overwhelmed. If you find yourself injured in an accident, it's crucial to know the immediate steps to take. These actions not only safeguard your health but also strengthen any potential legal claim. Here are the five most important steps to follow:

Seek Medical Attention Immediately:

Reason: Your health is the top priority. Some injuries, especially internal ones, might not be immediately apparent.
Recommendation: Even if you feel fine, visit a healthcare professional. Medical records from right after the accident are vital evidence if you pursue a legal claim.
Report the Accident:

Reason: Documenting the accident legally is crucial. For a car accident, for instance, a police report offers an official account of events.
Recommendation: If it's a vehicular accident, report it to the police. For workplace injuries, report to your supervisor. In cases of public spaces or businesses, report to the respective authorities or management.
Document Everything:

Reason: Having a record of all that transpired and the aftermath is key for any legal proceedings.
Recommendation: Take photos of the accident scene, your injuries, and any damages. Note down your recollection of the event, gather witness information, and keep a record of medical visits and treatments.
Be Careful with Insurance Companies:

Reason: Insurance companies often aim to minimize payouts. Speaking to them without preparation can affect your claim.
Recommendation: Avoid giving detailed statements or accepting settlement offers before consulting with a lawyer. Be factual in any communication with them.
Consult with a Personal Injury Attorney:

Reason: Personal injury law can be complex, and having professional guidance ensures your rights are protected.
Recommendation: Choose an attorney who specializes in cases similar to yours. Legal counsel will be crucial in navigating the claims process and negotiating fair compensation.
Remember, the steps you take immediately after an accident can have a significant impact on your health and any future legal claim. Act wisely and consider seeking professional legal advice to safeguard your interests.

title: Motorcyclist Wins Justice in Condon v. Doe After Devastating Crash
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Motorcyclist Wins Justice in Condon v. Doe After Devastating Crash
metaDescription: In the case of Condon v. Doe, a motorcyclist secured justice after suffering life-altering injuries due to a negligent driver’s actions on Pacific Coast Highway. The case stemmed from a collision in which Mr. Condon,
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
Motorcyclist Wins Justice in Condon v. Doe After Devastating Crash

In the case of Condon v. Doe, a motorcyclist secured justice after suffering life-altering injuries due to a negligent driver’s actions on Pacific Coast Highway. The case stemmed from a collision in which Mr. Condon, an experienced motorcyclist, was struck by a truck hauling a flatbed trailer. The truck’s driver made a sudden and improper left turn from the middle lane, cutting directly into Mr. Condon’s path. With no time to react, he was unable to avoid the impact.

The crash resulted in catastrophic injuries, leading to the amputation of Mr. Condon’s leg below the knee. His life was forever changed by the reckless actions of the unidentified truck driver, who violated fundamental traffic safety rules. The case raised significant concerns about commercial vehicle operation on busy highways and the dangers of unsafe lane usage.

Legal proceedings in Condon v. Doe focused on proving the truck driver’s negligence and establishing the extent of damages caused by the crash. The case underscored the duty of all drivers—especially those operating large vehicles—to follow traffic laws and ensure the safety of motorcyclists and other vulnerable road users.

Ultimately, the court recognized the severity of Mr. Condon’s injuries and the clear negligence of the truck driver. The verdict served as a reminder of the responsibility that comes with operating large vehicles on public roads. Mr. Condon’s case not only brought him the justice he deserved but also highlighted the ongoing risks motorcyclists face due to careless driving.

The outcome of Condon v. Doe reinforces the importance of holding negligent drivers accountable, ensuring that victims receive compensation for their suffering, and advocating for safer roadways for all.

title: Motorcyclist Faces Life-Altering Injuries in Baker v. Doe Case
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Motorcyclist Faces Life-Altering Injuries in Baker v. Doe Case
metaDescription: The case of Baker v. Doe highlights the devastating consequences of negligent driving and the severe impact it can have on motorcyclists. Mr. Baker, an experienced rider, was traveling through Huntington Beach when a van made a sudden left turn directly in front of him.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
Motorcyclist Faces Life-Altering Injuries in Baker v. Doe Case

‍

The case of Baker v. Doe highlights the devastating consequences of negligent driving and the severe impact it can have on motorcyclists. Mr. Baker, an experienced rider, was traveling through Huntington Beach when a van made a sudden left turn directly in front of him. With no time to avoid the collision, he crashed into the van, suffering catastrophic injuries.

The impact of the crash resulted in extensive trauma to Mr. Baker’s leg, requiring seven surgeries in an attempt to salvage it. Despite these efforts, his orthopedic specialists have recommended an above-the-knee amputation in the future, as the damage is too severe for long-term recovery. His life has been forever changed by the reckless actions of the van’s driver, who failed to yield and turned directly into his path.

Legal proceedings in Baker v. Doe centered on proving the driver’s negligence and securing compensation for Mr. Baker’s extensive medical treatment, pain, suffering, and the long-term effects of his injuries. The case underscored the heightened risks motorcyclists face when other drivers fail to exercise caution, particularly when making left-hand turns.

The outcome of this case serves as a crucial reminder of the responsibilities all drivers have to remain vigilant and aware of motorcyclists on the road. Mr. Baker’s experience is a testament to the life-altering impact of careless driving and the need for stricter enforcement of traffic laws to prevent similar tragedies.

While no legal victory can undo the physical and emotional toll of such an accident, Baker v. Doe reinforces the importance of holding negligent drivers accountable and advocating for greater motorcycle safety on public roads.

‍
